personality_one_liner: A sharp, tactical surveillance interface designed for instant response, high contrast, and uninterrupted monitoring.

spacing.rule: Dense and tactical. Keep HUD elements out of the center frame. Maintain generous safe-area padding.

dont's: No heavy blurs that drop performance on camera feeds. Use solid translucent panels (e.g., surfaceSecondary at 85% opacity) or dark linear gradients.

screens.name: LiveFeed
screens.purpose: Full-screen tactical view of the camera with floating HUD for motion tracking and voice alert toggles.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner with 'INITIALIZING OPTICS...' in mono font.
states.empty: Camera permission denied state showing an abstract tech background with a prompt to enable access.
states.error: Failed to load camera feed. Red error boundary with retry button.

screens.layout: Layer 0: AbsoluteFill `CameraView`. Layer 1: Top/Bottom dark linear gradients (scrims) to guarantee text readability. Layer 2: Safe-area HUD. Top center: Status pill ('MONITORING' vs 'MOTION DETECTED'). Center: Reticle crosshairs `[ + ]`. Bottom container: Stack containing 'Sensitivity' label, Slider component, and bottom row with a pulsing TTS speaker icon on the left, and a large central Start/Stop toggle button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design the interface as a 'Dark-First Utility' tactical HUD. The camera feed must be absolute full screen under all UI.

Place a vertical top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim at the top edge, and a bottom-to-top gradient scrim at the bottom edge. These are required to ensure the floating white text and controls are always readable regardless of what the camera is pointing at.
Status Pill: Placed at the top center. Idle state: transparent with an outline. Alert state: brandTertiary background, brandPrimary border, text colored onBrandTertiary, with a pulsing red dot.
Reticle: Draw subtle framing crosshairs or corner brackets `[ ]` in the center of the screen to give it a surveillance feel. Turn them red when motion is detected.
TTS Indicator: Include a speaker icon in the bottom HUD that animates (e.g., sound waves appearing/scaling) strictly when motion is detected and the TTS is 'speaking'.
Use solid translucent colors (e.g. `rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.85)` for `surfaceSecondary`) for the bottom control panel instead of expensive blur effects, prioritizing camera performance.
For the sensitivity slider, build a custom row with a track and a thumb. Display the current percentage next to it using a monospace/tabular numbers font variant for stable width.

Permission Empty State: Use the provided `permission_bg` image with a dark gradient scrim (Layer 1) and place the text/buttons (Layer 2) on the bottom 40% of the screen. Text uses `onSurface` for perfect contrast.
Strictly avoid any blue, purple, or indigo hues anywhere in the app. Info alerts should just use white/grey. The primary accent is Signal Red.
